title: Documents Required for Admission at KPGU
content:
Introduction
Official List of Documents Required for Admission at Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara: 1. Class 10th (SSC) Marksheet & Passing Certificate. 2. Class 12th (HSC) Marksheet & Passing Certificate. 3. Graduation Marksheets & Degree Certificate (for Postgraduate / Master's admissions). 4. Entrance Exam Score Card (KSET / GUJCET / NEET / ACPC Allotment Letter). 5. School Leaving Certificate (SLC) / Transfer Certificate (TC). 6.
